source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "resident welfare association" OR "residents' welfare association" OR "resident welfare associations"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"resident welfare association" OR "residents' welfare association" OR "resident welfare associations",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("resident welfare association" OR "resident welfare associations" OR "residents' welfare association")
